Bihar Farmers to Receive Rs 1,476 Crore Under PM Kisan Scheme

PM Kisan Nidhi Installment Disbursal in Bihar

Around 73 million (73 lakh) farmers across Bihar are set to receive financial support through the upcoming installment of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM Kisan) scheme. According to recent reports, a total of Rs 1,476 crore will be credited directly to the bank accounts of eligible beneficiaries.

A dedicated event to mark the disbursal is scheduled to take place at Gyan Bhawan, with state officials, beneficiary farmers, and the Chief Minister expected to participate.

Background and Financial Support

The PM Kisan Samman Nidhi is a central government initiative designed to provide financial assistance to landholding farmer families across India. Under the scheme, eligible farmers receive an annual financial support of Rs 6,000, distributed in periodic installments. With this upcoming transfer, the cumulative financial assistance disbursed to farmers in Bihar under the PM Kisan scheme will see a significant addition to the previously recorded total of Rs 33,000 crore.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For farmers awaiting the funds, this installment offers crucial financial backing for agricultural preparations and household needs.

  • Confirmed Details: Rs 1,476 crore is slated for disbursement to approximately 73 lakh farmers in Bihar. An event at Gyan Bhawan is planned for the rollout.
  • Unknowns and Uncertainties: The precise exact time of credit for individual bank accounts and specific beneficiary-level transaction logs may vary depending on banking processing times.
  • How to Verify: Beneficiaries can check their payment status and verify official updates directly through the official portal or news coverage provided by Navbharat Times. Farmers are advised to consult official government portals or local agricultural offices for direct confirmation regarding their specific account statuses.
